messages.subject: Query on plotting times
parts:
Hi all,

I have opened (imported) a CSV file that has 4 fields, Species, location
ID, date and time (24 clock).
The files are CSV formatted and dates are formatted as mmddyy and times
as 00:00 24 hr format.

When opened in the Deducer Data Viewer the dates and times are treated
as a Factor and not dates of times and if I go to variable view and
change the Type for time form Factor to time it deletes all the values
in this data field from the data table.

I want to do density plots with density on Y axis and time on X axis.
Alas seems I am not the sharpest Crayola in the box this morning and
seem not to be able to get this one working.

The end goal is to stack multiple plots (which works very nicely in Plot
Builder) and color by species to visually look at night time activity
patterns for comparison among them all.

Seems that this should be straight forward to have times on the X axis
in plot builder.

Bruce

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Query on plotting times
parts:
Bruce,

To convert the dates, open the data viewer in variable view. in type, select Date. A dialog will pop-up with date formats, click other. enter %m%d%y and click okay. Your dates should be converted.

If you don't get a pop-up make sure your Deducer is updated.


If you want to include your times, change your csv to have one column with both the data and hour. Preferably in a common format like: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss

Then do the same process you did for date, but selecting time and the appropriate datetime format in the pop-up.

ian
